persona.name: Jamie
persona.description: Original fictional adult, age 25, olive skin, wavy dark hair, light stubble, round dark glasses and charcoal hoodie. Warm direct-to-camera presenter, with an original voice.
persona.wardrobe: Charcoal hoodie and relaxed charcoal trousers, no logos.
persona.environment: Modest neighborhood cafe in daylight. One table, dark ceiling beams, soft window light and neutral phone prop. Fix the background and remove the inconsistent clip-on microphone before production.
persona.rationale: Original character adapted to the observed candid hoodie/cafe format. The earlier evening-sofa concept is retained as v1, but v2 is the selected demo direction. No Xander or Donald likeness, voice or personal testimony.
